name: chms
description: ChMS - Church Management System (Ghana): members, services, giving, SMS, follow-up

scripts.build: npm run build -w @chms/shared && npm run build -w @chms/db && npm run build -w @chms/api && npm run build -w @chms/worker && npm run build -w @chms/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chms/shared && npm run typecheck -w @chms/db && npm run typecheck -w @chms/api && npm run typecheck -w @chms/worker && npm run typecheck -w @chms/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @chms/shared && npm run test -w @chms/api && npm run test -w @chms/worker
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:extras && npm run db:appuser && npm run db:seed
